i.norm: Verifies that {@code writeShapeByTypeIfSupported} returns {@code false} when the given type byte is not {@code TYPE_GEOM} (the JTS geometry marker). In that case the codec delegates to the superclass, which does not recognise type 0 either and returns false. The shape argument is null because the type check short-circuits before the shape is used.
type byte 0 is not TYPE_GEOM, so the codec does not handle it
